question: How do memory architecture and dependency-requiring supervision interact in useful long-context reasoning at fixed resource budgets?

core.branching: For each architecture and seed, train one base plus shared natural-document continuation parent; branch both supervision recipes from its identical weights and optimizer state. Every branch is new training; count parent/shared continuation once.
core.endpoint_freeze: Targets are cost hypotheses. R0/R1 must freeze achievable shared endpoints, effective supervised tokens, tolerances, LR, batches, evaluation and stop rules before any R2 confirmatory training. Reduce endpoints symmetrically before outputs if required; preserve three complete paired seeds.
core.cost_accounting: Parent training, common continuation, both branches, setup, checkpoints and failures count inside 360 hours. R4 and V1 own scheduled scientific evaluation; do not double charge.

transfer.choice_rule: Choose preferred if the full two-parent/four-branch program fits measured costs; otherwise choose fallback, before any R2 confirmation outputs. Freeze continuation and branch endpoints. Neither route affordable means stop for a costed successor, not an unfunded run.
transfer.reuse: Fresh independent seed; do not reuse a differently seeded R2 parent as a paired control. All training to the final parent horizon is charged.
transfer.claim_boundary: One paired seed is a directional transfer check, not population equivalence. Fallback supports horizon only. Neither path establishes 1.2B/320B causal superiority or a scaling law.

estimands.primary: Equal-family macro task quality on fixed 32K evaluation cases; report each family, each seed, and natural versus controlled sources separately.
estimands.training_effect: Mean over architectures of targeted-minus-standard quality within seed.
estimands.architecture_effect: Mean over training recipes of hybrid-minus-dense quality within seed.
cost_views: fixed analytic-FLOP endpoint from frozen checkpoint interpolation
fixed wall-clock endpoint from frozen checkpoint interpolation
estimands.supervision_matching: If matching tolerances fail, retain as a training-package comparison and remove isolated-dependency wording.

analysis.seed_unit: Compute contrasts inside each complete seed block; three seed contrasts define training uncertainty, not documents as independent training replicates.
analysis.intervals: Two-sided 95% Student-t intervals on the three paired-seed contrasts, plus separately labeled family/document bootstrap evaluation uncertainty. Retain all cells and failed pairs; no seed replacement selected by quality.
analysis.multiplicity: Three confirmatory contrasts form one family: report raw and Holm-adjusted two-sided p-values, unadjusted 95% intervals clearly labeled, and every task-family guardrail.
analysis.null: An interval spanning zero is unresolved. Additivity/equivalence requires predeclared equivalence margins and corresponding tests; no absence-of-significance claim.
analysis.power: R1 uses disjoint pilot cases to estimate floor/ceiling, variance and detectable effect. Report limited power; do not promise interaction significance with three seeds. If underpowered, narrow the inference claim before confirmation.
analysis.failed_runs: Technical failures may restart identically within budget; quality failures remain results. Missing cells invalidate the complete-block estimand for that seed and narrow inference.
analysis.mechanism: Small evaluation-only evidence removal/update controls and KDA-state interventions are diagnostics with distribution-shift caveats, not extra training arms.

selection.rule: Promote dependency supervision only if the paired average training effect is positive and its Holm-adjusted two-sided p-value is below 0.05, every predeclared per-family and short/general non-inferiority gate passes, the within-hybrid training contrast is positive and passes its predeclared non-inferiority guardrails, and measured cost fits. A pooled gain cannot override a hybrid regression. Significant interaction is not required for promotion. Otherwise retain standard supervision and publish null/trade-off.
selection.flagship: One fixed hybrid architecture; validate the selected recipe on its development dashboard. Before/after flagship measurements support stage improvement, not a same-budget dense counterfactual.
selection.sealed_audit: Open once after final model, inference settings, primary analyses and headlines-to-test are frozen; a failed audit narrows claims, never retunes the same test.

freeze_requirements: per-arm processed and supervised token endpoints
